item.headinajar.collar_cam.how: Bolted to your neck: your body sees through it.

dolores.headinajar.start: DOLORES: Thank you for choosing Elective Separation. Please keep your arms inside the chair.
dolores.headinajar.gas: DOLORES: Administering a pleasant gas. Breathe normally. Or don't.
dolores.headinajar.scan: DOLORES: Scanning. Please hold still. You have a lovely neck.
dolores.headinajar.cut: DOLORES: Commencing separation. This will not hurt for very long.
dolores.headinajar.jar: DOLORES: Your head is now in a jar. Congratulations on your promotion.
dolores.headinajar.done: DOLORES: Neuro-link established. Please collect your head on the way out.
dolores.headinajar.abort: DOLORES: Procedure cancelled. Your head remains attached. For now.
dolores.headinajar.new_blade: DOLORES: New blade fitted. So shiny.
dolores.headinajar.refuse.power: DOLORES: Insufficient power. I refuse to stop halfway.
dolores.headinajar.refuse.jar: DOLORES: Where would we put your head? Insert a Life Support Jar.
dolores.headinajar.refuse.goggles: DOLORES: Relay Goggles required. You will want to see.
dolores.headinajar.refuse.collar: DOLORES: Collar Cam required. Your neck needs a hat.
dolores.headinajar.refuse.saline: DOLORES: Four bottles of Cranial Saline, please. Heads get thirsty.
dolores.headinajar.refuse.already: DOLORES: Our records show your head is already off.
gui.headinajar.chair.sit: Sit in the chair to sign
gui.headinajar.chair.form.body: I, %s, consent to the removal of my head, and accept that it is now company property.

mecha_module.headinajar.signal_booster.d: A moving relay for your link.

-40% explosion and projectile damage, 6 charges (one back per 30 s).

mecha_module.headinajar.workbench.desc: A crafting grid on the go.

mecha_module.headinajar.harvester.desc: Picks and replants ripe crops in a 5x5.

mecha_module.headinajar.plasma_lance.des: Hold: a 32-block beam, 20 damage a second. Very hot.
mecha_module.headinajar.ore_scanner.desc: Ping: marks ores within 8 to 24 blocks for 5 s (Radius).
mecha_module.headinajar.target_lock.desc: Your aim drifts onto hostiles near the crosshair.

item.headinajar.collar_wide_lens.desc: A wider view through the feed.
item.headinajar.collar_periscope_stalk.d: Your body stands at full height again.
item.headinajar.collar_zoom_optic.desc: Hold the zoom key (C) for x3 zoom.
message.headinajar.tipped: You tip the jar over. Roll, very slowly. Press V again to sit up.
gui.headinajar.courier.tooltip: Stranded? A Noggin & Sons courier brings your body to your head in 30 seconds, from anywhere. Fee: 20 kFE of charge, or all you have if less.
courier.headinajar.booked: Courier booked: your body arrives in 30 seconds
courier.headinajar.delivered: Delivery for you: one body, slightly used. Press Swap to get back in.
courier.headinajar.lost: The courier could not find your body. Fee refunded. A %s can print a new one.
courier.headinajar.only_jars: Only a head in a jar can book the courier
courier.headinajar.no_body: You have no body to deliver
courier.headinajar.on_its_way: The courier is already on the way
fml.menu.mods.info.description.headinaja: Take your head off and live in a life-support jar: drive your own headless body over a neuro-link, borrow mob bodies, build mecha, splice genes and put jarred heads to work.
jei.headinajar.separation_chair: Load a jar, goggles, Collar Cam and four bottles of Cranial Saline, power it, sit down and sign Form 27-B. It takes your head off and leaves your body linked to it.
jei.headinajar.life_support_cradle: Docks a head: keeps its saline and charge topped up and boosts the link.
jei.headinajar.saline_mixer: Water, sugar, kelp and redstone with power make Cranial Saline. Glass bottles are filled from its tank.
jei.headinajar.body_printer: Prints a new headless body from saline and power for a head that has lost its own.
jei.headinajar.surgical_saw: Use on a creature below 25% health: its body becomes a host. With an empty jar in the other hand you keep its head instead.
jei.headinajar.assembly_gantry: Put a frame and modules in, then Assemble (10,000 FE). Take Apart pulls a mecha back into the slots; Repair spends Mecha Plating.
jei.headinajar.centrifuge: Spins a Blood Sample into a DNA Fraction and a Plasma Vial. Dragon's breath gives Ender Dragon DNA.
jei.headinajar.dna_sequencer: Reads a DNA Fraction into your gene library: auto-read at 60%, or call the twelve bases yourself for up to 100%.
jei.headinajar.gene_splicer: Splices up to three library genes (at least 30% read) into a Serum Cassette with Bio-Gel, a glass bottle and an optional catalyst.
jei.headinajar.injection_rig: Injects the serum in its slot into your own body (with your head on, or linked).
jei.headinajar.leech_jar: Takes a small blood sample every 30 s from a creature standing next to it.
jei.headinajar.syringe: Use on a living creature to draw a Blood Sample. Healthier creatures give better quality.
jei.headinajar.serum_cassette: Made at the Gene Splicer. Use it on a host or a Chimera, or load it into an Injection Rig.
jei.headinajar.turret_pedestal: Fit a jarred mob head: it guards the area the way that mob fights. Skeletons need arrows in a chest below.
jei.headinajar.cerebral_array: Up to nine jarred heads make FE from Nutrient Broth. Five or more hold a Board Meeting (+10%).
jei.headinajar.employee_mount: Hang a jarred villager on a machine: their profession gives that machine a bonus, for an emerald a day.
jei.headinajar.neural_socket: Plug your jar in to drive six redstone channels, or let a mob head run a program.
jei.headinajar.entangled_pair: Use it to split it into two shards. Craft one with your goggles and the other with your Collar Cam: the link then crosses dimensions.
jei.headinajar.emp_grenade: Throw it: links break (unless shielded), jars and mecha lose power, turrets go dark.
jei.headinajar.jarred_head: A mob's head in a jar, from the Surgical Saw with an empty jar in your off hand. Villagers keep trading; other heads work in turrets, the Array and sockets.
jei.headinajar.frame: Assemble it at the Assembly Gantry with modules in the slots of the right kind.

book.headinajar.written.1:
Noggin & Sons
EMPLOYEE HANDBOOK

The opening chapters.

The full handbook, with every department, comes with the Patchouli mod. Lost this copy? A book and a Surgical Steel Blend make another.
book.headinajar.written.2:
WELCOME

Congratulations on joining Head Office. This handbook covers what an employee needs, from the Separation Chair to keeping your head topped up with Cranial Saline.
book.headinajar.written.3: Start with Surgical Steel: smelt a blend of iron, bone meal and coal. Then make Neuro-Copper Wire, a Lens and a Servo. Power comes from a Galvanic Pile fed with meat or rotten flesh.
book.headinajar.written.4:
THE SEPARATION CHAIR

Load the chair with a Life Support Jar, Relay Goggles, a Collar Cam and four bottles of Cranial Saline, and give it 40 kFE. Sit down and hold Sign on Form 27-B.
book.headinajar.written.5: You may get up until the cut. After that, DOLORES will finish what she started. A worn blade can botch the job: keep a Replacement Blade handy.
book.headinajar.written.6:
THE NEURO-LINK

After the cut you walk around in your own headless body and see through the Collar Cam. Your head wears the goggles and sends the signal. The further apart they are, the worse the picture.
book.headinajar.written.7: Water, rock, storms, portals and the Warden all hurt the signal. At zero for five seconds you wake up in your head. Press %s to swap between body and head yourself.
book.headinajar.written.8: Carry your head in a Head Satchel for a perfect link, or dock it in a Life Support Cradle. Relay Masts pass the signal along: masts reach each other and your body within their radius.
book.headinajar.written.9:
WHEN IT GOES WRONG

If your body dies, it becomes a corpse that keeps your things, and you wake up in your head. As a jar, use a Suture Kit on the corpse to get back into it, or print a new body.
book.headinajar.written.10: If your head is destroyed while you are out walking, that is a real death. Guard it. A Signal Jammer near your enemies works wonders.
book.headinajar.written.11:
GETTING HOME

Walk too far and the link breaks: you wake up in your head. A jar with the Wheels module drives at half walking speed: press %s. Without wheels the same key tips the jar on its side to roll, very slowly.
book.headinajar.written.12: Stranded anyway? Press Courier in the jar menu. A Noggin & Sons courier delivers your body to your head in 30 seconds, from anywhere, for 20 kFE of charge (or all you have, if less). Then press %s.
